subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Other students can take it home and keep it.”?
options: Then a student suggested adding a tag inside each raincoat: "Please bring me home tomorrow.
It had textbooks, notebooks, old test papers, two water bottles, and things he did not remember putting inside.
Students must bring a sleeping bag, a water bottle, and a jacket.
Please do not bring workbooks, test papers, or books with missing pages.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Other students can take it home and keep it. Please do not bring workbooks, test papers, or books with missing pages.」，答案為「Please do not bring workbooks, test papers, or books with missing pages.」。
